title: Identifiability and Estimation for Unlabeled Finite Mixtures under Marginal Independence
abstract: arXiv:2606.07914v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study component recovery and mixing-matrix estimation from unlabeled finite mixtures whose observable distributions share the same latent components but have unknown mixing weights. The main identifying signal is marginal independence: each component is assumed to be independent on at least one coordinate pair, but no labels, clean component samples, or mixing weights are observed. We first prove a structural result for product components: under a subset-rank condition on the spans of the univariate marginals, any independent affine combination of the components must coincide with a single component. We then extend this principle to observable mixtures and show that, under the corresponding subset-rank, full-rank, and no-cancellation conditions, marginally independent affine combinations recover the corresponding latent components. When every component is independent on some coordinate pair, all components are identifiable,

translated_title: 边际独立下未标记有限混合模型的可辨识性与估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.07914v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们研究了从未标记的有限混合模型中恢复成分和估计混合矩阵的问题，其中可观测分布共享相同的潜在成分，但混合权重未知。主要识别信号是边际独立性：每个成分被假设在至少一个坐标对上是独立的，但未观察到标签、纯净成分样本或混合权重。我们首先证明了乘积成分的一个结构结果：在单变量边际张成的子集秩条件下，任何独立的仿射组合必须与单个成分一致。然后，我们将这一原理扩展到可观测混合模型，并表明在相应的子集秩、满秩和无消去条件下，边际独立的仿射组合能够恢复对应的潜在成分。当每个成分在某个坐标对上是独立的时，所有成分都是可辨识的。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于边际独立性的方法，用于从未标记的有限混合模型中识别和估计潜在成分，通过子集秩条件确保仿射组合的唯一性，从而实现全部成分的可辨识性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a marginal-independence-based approach to identify and estimate latent components from unlabeled finite mixtures, ensuring full identifiability via subset-rank conditions on affine combinations.
